text: The Bible experts knew where the King would be born. Did they go?
About seven hundred years earlier, a prophet called Micah, a man who spoke God's message, named a small town: Bethlehem. Out of it, he said, a ruler would come,
that is to be ruler in Israel.
Mary and Joseph lived far away. A tax order sent them to Bethlehem. There, Jesus was born. Wise men from the east came asking for the one born King. King Herod asked the experts where.
The Bible never says the experts went. The wise men went, and found the child.
But Jesus had come much farther. He came down from heaven. He died for our sins. He rose again the third day.
Before anyone went to Him, He came to us.
